source: https://certifier.io/ (inline <svg> in the header link a[aria-label="Certifier logo"])

removed the 'Certifier' letters (element 0, one compound path)

notes: The reviewer's note is right: the previous file (res.cloudinary.com/certifier/.../logo_usyzm8.svg) is the Penn State Nittany Lion shield, a customer logo in Certifier's homepage carousel, not Certifier's mark. certifier.io/favicon/safari-pinned-tab.svg, linked as mask-icon, returns the site's HTML 404 page. The light file keeps a harmless Tailwind class attribute from the inline source.
